The '''''Skywatcher''-class deep space scout ship''' was a [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] for the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="BtR" />

==Characteristics==
Extremely fast and reliable, ''Skywatchers'' were designed for rapid deployment to poorly scouted sections of space, and were a proven favorite among scouts. The size of a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], ''skywatchers'' had a stark and austere interior that often drove crew members to provide decoration of their own; typically carrying a crew of three to twelve depending on the mission assignment, a compliment of [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] and their [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] was often part of this crew.<ref name="BtR" />

Though shielded, the ''Skywatcher'' was relatively lightly armed; as a result crews were far more likely to use its speed to run away than to fight when outnumbered or outgunned. As a scout ship, the craft was well equipped to handle planetary scans, surveys, and navigate stellar phenomena such as nebulas. As an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scout craft, the ship also contained a compliment of twelve probe droids of various models, and was capable of deploying the droids in atmosphere, or into space via [[Hyperdrive pod/Legends|hyperspace pod]].<ref name="BtR" />
